meta.title: Sincere Heart - 2
meta.description: I am not true to myself because I am a Sanctifier, but I am a Sanctifier because I am true to myself.

units.rawText: I seem to have... delved quite far in. Darkness surrounds me and there is nothing in the world but I and the girl in front of me.
units.displayText: I seem to have... delved quite far in. Darkness surrounds me and there is nothing in the world but I and the girl in front of me.

spans.text: I seem to have... delved quite far in. Darkness surrounds me and there is nothing in the world but I and the girl in front of me.

units.rawText: Her tone and voice were both unbelievably familiar. The black muck gradually swallows her as she tries to escape, struggling powerlessly as she disappears into the darkness.
units.displayText: Her tone and voice were both unbelievably familiar. The black muck gradually swallows her as she tries to escape, struggling powerlessly as she disappears into the darkness.

spans.text: Her tone and voice were both unbelievably familiar. The black muck gradually swallows her as she tries to escape, struggling powerlessly as she disappears into the darkness.

units.rawText: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.
units.displayText: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.

spans.text: Ah... this sound of desperation is music to the ears.

units.rawText: Do not worry, it will not take me long for you to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Do not worry, it will not take me long for you to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Do not worry, it will not take me long for you to consume you. After that, I shall be whole as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: I feel a sense of catharsis as I speak. How simple, how beautiful it is to follow your heart's desires, unbound by those oaths...
units.displayText: I feel a sense of catharsis as I speak. How simple, how beautiful it is to follow your heart's desires, unbound by those oaths...

spans.text: I feel a sense of catharsis as I speak. How simple, how beautiful it is to follow your heart's desires, unbound by those oaths...

units.rawText: ...Oaths? Right, what are those?
units.displayText: ...Oaths? Right, what are those?

spans.text: ...Oaths? Right, what are those?

units.rawText: So, any last words you'd like to say?
units.displayText: So, any last words you'd like to say?

spans.text: So, any last words you'd like to say?

units.rawText: Gah...
units.displayText: Gah...

spans.text: Gah...

units.rawText: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We... hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: ...No, that's not right.
units.displayText: ...No, that's not right.

spans.text: ...No, that's not right.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: That's not what I remember. You should aggrieve, you should curse.
units.displayText: That's not what I remember. You should aggrieve, you should curse.

spans.text: That's not what I remember. You should aggrieve, you should curse.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Why is it that at a time like this, you still repeat...
units.displayText: Why is it that at a time like this, you still repeat...

spans.text: Why is it that at a time like this, you still repeat...

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth...
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth...

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth...

units.rawText: ...These Sanctifier oaths?
units.displayText: ...These Sanctifier oaths?

spans.text: ...These Sanctifier oaths?

units.rawText: ...The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will...
units.displayText: ...The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will...

spans.text: ...The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will...

units.rawText: ...and seek their glory.
units.displayText: ...and seek their glory.

spans.text: ...and seek their glory.

units.rawText: I instinctively speak the words. Something is suddenly illuminated and the muddiness in my mind disappears along with the black muck.
units.displayText: I instinctively speak the words. Something is suddenly illuminated and the muddiness in my mind disappears along with the black muck.

spans.text: I instinctively speak the words. Something is suddenly illuminated and the muddiness in my mind disappears along with the black muck.

units.rawText: It was as if I had returned to that afternoon.
units.displayText: It was as if I had returned to that afternoon.

spans.text: It was as if I had returned to that afternoon.

units.rawText: Upon the Plaza of Oaths, countless commemorative steles stand in silence, bearing innumerable inscribed names.
units.displayText: Upon the Plaza of Oaths, countless commemorative steles stand in silence, bearing innumerable inscribed names.

spans.text: Upon the Plaza of Oaths, countless commemorative steles stand in silence, bearing innumerable inscribed names.

units.rawText: Lord... Hesperus... please excuse the interruption. I have a question I wanted to ask you.
units.displayText: Lord... Hesperus... please excuse the interruption. I have a question I wanted to ask you.

spans.text: Lord... Hesperus... please excuse the interruption. I have a question I wanted to ask you.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: I hesitate for a time, asking a question that had troubled me for quite some time.
units.displayText: I hesitate for a time, asking a question that had troubled me for quite some time.

spans.text: I hesitate for a time, asking a question that had troubled me for quite some time.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus... Have you ever heard the voices of bygone Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus... Have you ever heard the voices of bygone Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Lord Hesperus... Have you ever heard the voices of bygone Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader places the ceremonial flowers at the stele's feet.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader places the ceremonial flowers at the stele's feet.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader places the ceremonial flowers at the stele's feet.

units.rawText: What do you mean?
units.displayText: What do you mean?

spans.text: What do you mean?

units.rawText: It is... difficult to explain.
units.displayText: It is... difficult to explain.

spans.text: It is... difficult to explain.

units.rawText: I only hear it when I come near the steles.
units.displayText: I only hear it when I come near the steles.

spans.text: I only hear it when I come near the steles.

units.rawText: At first they were just ever-converging wails, but as time passed, their voices became clearer.
units.displayText: At first they were just ever-converging wails, but as time passed, their voices became clearer.

spans.text: At first they were just ever-converging wails, but as time passed, their voices became clearer.

units.rawText: In the images constructed by their words, I saw countless scenes of Sanctifier sacrifice.
units.displayText: In the images constructed by their words, I saw countless scenes of Sanctifier sacrifice.

spans.text: In the images constructed by their words, I saw countless scenes of Sanctifier sacrifice.

units.rawText: The inscribed names in vision twist and reconstruct, piecing together the curse that haunted me till now.
units.displayText: The inscribed names in vision twist and reconstruct, piecing together the curse that haunted me till now.

spans.text: The inscribed names in vision twist and reconstruct, piecing together the curse that haunted me till now.

units.rawText: "I don't want to die!"
units.displayText: "I don't want to die!"

spans.text: "I don't want to die!"

units.rawText: "Why must I be the one to die?"
units.displayText: "Why must I be the one to die?"

spans.text: "Why must I be the one to die?"

units.rawText: "Why should I give my life to protect them?"
units.displayText: "Why should I give my life to protect them?"

spans.text: "Why should I give my life to protect them?"

units.rawText: Even in the brightly sunny midday, a fierce cold surrounds me, encasing me in a prison of ice as I call up these memories.
units.displayText: Even in the brightly sunny midday, a fierce cold surrounds me, encasing me in a prison of ice as I call up these memories.

spans.text: Even in the brightly sunny midday, a fierce cold surrounds me, encasing me in a prison of ice as I call up these memories.

units.rawText: I clasp my arms tight, attempting to hold onto the warmth left in my body, lest the spirits of the deceased steal it away.
units.displayText: I clasp my arms tight, attempting to hold onto the warmth left in my body, lest the spirits of the deceased steal it away.

spans.text: I clasp my arms tight, attempting to hold onto the warmth left in my body, lest the spirits of the deceased steal it away.

units.rawText: ...I know that these might well be the whispers of daemons, but my system inspections have not discovered any abnormalities.
units.displayText: ...I know that these might well be the whispers of daemons, but my system inspections have not discovered any abnormalities.

spans.text: ...I know that these might well be the whispers of daemons, but my system inspections have not discovered any abnormalities.

units.rawText: So...
units.displayText: So...

spans.text: So...

units.rawText: So you've come to ask me if I have encountered something similar?
units.displayText: So you've come to ask me if I have encountered something similar?

spans.text: So you've come to ask me if I have encountered something similar?

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: I'm afraid I will have to disappoint you then.
units.displayText: I'm afraid I will have to disappoint you then.

spans.text: I'm afraid I will have to disappoint you then.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: I shall have Eosphorus inspect your Sacred Canon to make sure you have not been affected... But I can be sure of one thing.
units.displayText: I shall have Eosphorus inspect your Sacred Canon to make sure you have not been affected... But I can be sure of one thing.

spans.text: I shall have Eosphorus inspect your Sacred Canon to make sure you have not been affected... But I can be sure of one thing.

units.rawText: I look up to find suppressed anger in the leader's eyes.
units.displayText: I look up to find suppressed anger in the leader's eyes.

spans.text: I look up to find suppressed anger in the leader's eyes.

units.rawText: The daemonic whispers you have heard are the work of another and not the words of the fallen.
units.displayText: The daemonic whispers you have heard are the work of another and not the words of the fallen.

spans.text: The daemonic whispers you have heard are the work of another and not the words of the fallen.

units.rawText: How can you be so certain?
units.displayText: How can you be so certain?

spans.text: How can you be so certain?

units.rawText: ...Because I have witnessed each and every single person's resolve myself.
units.displayText: ...Because I have witnessed each and every single person's resolve myself.

spans.text: ...Because I have witnessed each and every single person's resolve myself.

units.rawText: A wind arises out of nowhere, scattering the flowers through the air.
units.displayText: A wind arises out of nowhere, scattering the flowers through the air.

spans.text: A wind arises out of nowhere, scattering the flowers through the air.

units.rawText: Perhaps to you they are only pieces of history recorded upon the steles, but to me they are irreplaceable, unforgettable comrades.
units.displayText: Perhaps to you they are only pieces of history recorded upon the steles, but to me they are irreplaceable, unforgettable comrades.

spans.text: Perhaps to you they are only pieces of history recorded upon the steles, but to me they are irreplaceable, unforgettable comrades.

units.rawText: That is why I am so certain—the people I knew wouldn't be so pathetic as to cry and lament over such sacrifice.
units.displayText: That is why I am so certain—the people I knew wouldn't be so pathetic as to cry and lament over such sacrifice.

spans.text: That is why I am so certain—the people I knew wouldn't be so pathetic as to cry and lament over such sacrifice.

units.rawText: Do you know why Eosphorus and I chose the stars and fire to be the manifestation of our powers?
units.displayText: Do you know why Eosphorus and I chose the stars and fire to be the manifestation of our powers?

spans.text: Do you know why Eosphorus and I chose the stars and fire to be the manifestation of our powers?

units.rawText: The sudden question causes me to shake my head. I had never considered the question before Hesperus asked.
units.displayText: The sudden question causes me to shake my head. I had never considered the question before Hesperus asked.

spans.text: The sudden question causes me to shake my head. I had never considered the question before Hesperus asked.

units.rawText: The stars guide the way ahead and the flame lights the path beneath our feet.
units.displayText: The stars guide the way ahead and the flame lights the path beneath our feet.

spans.text: The stars guide the way ahead and the flame lights the path beneath our feet.

units.rawText: We all once feared the darkness, but that is why we do not wish for others to forget the light.
units.displayText: We all once feared the darkness, but that is why we do not wish for others to forget the light.

spans.text: We all once feared the darkness, but that is why we do not wish for others to forget the light.

units.rawText: If the day of sacrifice ever comes for me, I hope to be like them.
units.displayText: If the day of sacrifice ever comes for me, I hope to be like them.

spans.text: If the day of sacrifice ever comes for me, I hope to be like them.

units.rawText: Before I can follow up, Hesperus' silhouette had already departed.
units.displayText: Before I can follow up, Hesperus' silhouette had already departed.

spans.text: Before I can follow up, Hesperus' silhouette had already departed.

units.rawText: I gaze upwards at the steles once more. The curses and banes had disappeared, returning to countless gently shining names.
units.displayText: I gaze upwards at the steles once more. The curses and banes had disappeared, returning to countless gently shining names.

spans.text: I gaze upwards at the steles once more. The curses and banes had disappeared, returning to countless gently shining names.
